instructions.name: claim_prize
docs: Claim prize for a specific tier
Winner calls this after being finalized by judges.
Transfers funds from vault to winner's wallet.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow account containing prize tier information

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault PDA that holds the locked SOL
This account will have SOL deducted when prize is claimed

accounts.name: winner
docs: Winner claiming the prize (must be a signer)
This must match the winner recorded in the escrow tier

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for transferring SOL

instructions.name: finalize_winner
docs: Finalize winner for a specific tier
Judges sign off-chain, signatures are verified on-chain.
When threshold is met, winner is recorded for the tier.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow account containing judge list and prize tiers

accounts.name: organizer
docs: The organizer account (optional, for future use)
We don't strictly need the organizer to call this -
anyone can submit valid signatures (permissionless!)

instructions.name: initialize_escrow
docs: Initialize a new bounty escrow
Creates an escrow account and locks funds in a vault PDA.
Organizer specifies judges, voting threshold, prize tiers, and deadline.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow account that stores all metadata

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault account that holds the locked SOL

accounts.name: organizer
docs: Organizer who is creating the bounty

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for account creation and transfers

instructions.name: refund_unclaimed
docs: Refund unclaimed prizes to organizer after deadline
Organizer calls this after deadline passes to reclaim
funds for prizes that were never claimed.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow account containing prize tier information

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault PDA that holds the locked SOL
This account will have unclaimed SOL transferred back to organizer

accounts.name: organizer
docs: Organizer receiving the refund (must be a signer)
This must match the organizer recorded in the escrow

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program for transferring SOL

errors.name: InsufficientSignatures
errors.msg: Insufficient signatures - need more judge approvals

errors.name: TierAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This tier has already been claimed

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Deadline has not been reached yet

errors.name: EscrowExpired
errors.msg: Escrow has expired - claiming period is over

errors.name: InvalidJudge
errors.msg: Invalid judge - not in authorized judge list

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: Invalid tier index - tier does not exist

errors.name: InvalidThreshold
errors.msg: Threshold must be less than or equal to number of judges

errors.name: NoJudges
errors.msg: Must have at least one judge

errors.name: NoTiers
errors.msg: Must have at least one prize tier

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Deadline must be in the future

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized - you are not the organizer

errors.name: AlreadyFinalized
errors.msg: Winner already finalized for this tier

errors.name: NotFinalized
errors.msg: Cannot claim - winner not yet finalized

errors.name: InvalidMessage
errors.msg: Message format invalid for signature verification

errors.name: DeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: Deadline has not passed yet - cannot refund

errors.name: NoUnclaimedFunds
errors.msg: No unclaimed funds available to refund

types.name: Escrow
docs: Main escrow account that holds all bounty metadata

fields.name: organizer
docs: Organizer's public key (who created the escrow)

fields.name: judges
docs: List of judge public keys (e.g., 5 judges)

fields.name: threshold
docs: Minimum number of judges required to approve a winner (e.g., 3 out of 5)

fields.name: tiers
docs: Prize tiers in lamports (e.g., [20 SOL, 15 SOL, 10 SOL, 5 SOL])

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix timestamp for when unclaimed funds can be refunded

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the escrow PDA

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: Bump seed for the vault PDA (holds the actual SOL)

types.name: PrizeTier
docs: Individual prize tier with winner and claim status

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount of SOL for this tier (in lamports)

fields.name: winner
docs: Winner's public key (None if not yet assigned)

fields.name: claimed
docs: Whether this tier has been claimed
